LinearLayout.android:contentDescription: Learn how Sentinel uninstall protection works

TextView.android:text: It adds Android Device Admin protection, so Sentinel cannot be uninstalled until Device Admin is deactivated.
Before deleting Sentinel from the child phone, remove that child from the parent dashboard.
To uninstall, first deactivate Sentinel in Device Admin settings, then delete the app normally.
